description: Routing policy for the primary-agent coordinator (Group 2). The coordinator only does trivial work itself and dispatches everything above trivial to a worker. The router picks the cheapest capable model and accounts for the token cost of switching mid-turn and for prompt length. Config values here are the baked-in defaults; env vars and the merged pipeline config (Group 6) override them. defaultCodeWorker / cheapBasicWorker live in runtime/models.json -> registry.workerModels and are read from there, not duplicated here.

switchCostModel.decision: Upgrade to a stronger worker than the cheapest capable one only when qualityGain * taskValue (scaled to token-equivalent benefit) exceeds the switch cost. A longer prompt raises the switch cost, so a marginal gain stops being worth it.
